readyAssistDerivation.conclusion: The ship rides the READY corridor exactly (55.00 at and below the 185 activation shell, 61.59 against a 61.09 limit at d=197). Under the unready law it could not have gone below 300 at all. Approach assist was published with ready:true and the ship reached INSIDE the 185-unit activation envelope on both cycles.
readyAssistDerivation.evidenceClass: derived (exact arithmetic on captured pose/velocity against frozen source constants), not a live read of the ready flag

candidateDisposition.because: measured centre distance reached 181.23 and 169.09; measured speeds match the READY corridor law exactly and violate the unready law by construction

sourceHandoffImplicated.notAsserted: this report does NOT assert which of the two epoch increments is which, nor which module issues the second one. No repair is authorized or proposed.

Whether the second epoch increment is setActiveSystemPlanet('-1,-1:p1'), commitSystemBodyTarget, clearSystemTarget, or resetSystemFlightForInterstellarArrival is UNDETERMINED from window-exposed state.
